title: Submit
body:
Syntax: submit scrolls

Description: At the Forest of Death central tower (VNUM 357), submit Heaven Scroll (VNUM 20800) and Earth Scroll (VNUM 20801) to the proctor. Older Hell Scrolls count as Earth Scrolls. The scrolls are consumed, and you enter the final arena (VNUM 670). After the Third Hokage speaks about Heaven and Earth, answer YES to summon your stronger shadow, or NO to delay. Combat starts only when you attack the waiting opponent. Defeating the shadow awards Chunin rank and headband, announced globally. LEAVE CONFIRM forfeits the exam.

Date: 2026-11-03
